# CANDIDATE: BASELINE_EDGE_CAPTURE_MEASUREMENT

**Filed:** 2026-08-24  
**Filer:** chef-nemotron (free-tier autonomous R&D)  
**Type:** quality_gate  
**Status:** DRAFT (NEEDS-RATIFICATION per Rule 9)

## Hypothesis

We need a quantified baseline edge_capture for the current engine to evaluate future improvements against the OP-16 anchor days. Without a measured baseline, we cannot determine whether a candidate truly improves edge_capture beyond the 771 threshold (50% of max possible 1542). This candidate establishes that baseline via Stage-1 backtest, walk-forward OOS, and real-fills validation.

## Mechanism

1. Run the Stage-1 autoresearch grinder harness over the full 16-month OPRA cache (2025-01-02 through 2026-06-18) to compute edge_capture = sum(engine_pnl_on_J_winners) - sum(max(0, engine_loss_on_J_losers)) for the six J anchor days.
2. Perform a walk-forward out-of-sample test: split data into training (first 12 months) and testing (last 4 months); compute edge_capture OOS on the J days that fall in the test window.
3. Validate simulator accuracy by running real-fills simulation (cached OPRA bid/ask, slippage model) on the top-3 J anchor days (4/29, 5/01, 5/04) and ensuring the diff from BS-sim is < ±20%.
4. Record all results, including concentration metrics (top-5 days % of P&L) and failure-mode analysis.

## OP-20 disclosures

1. **Account-size assumption:** qty=28 requires $25K+; $1K paper ~= 14% headline (per OP-20 disclosure #1).
2. **Sample bias:** Full 16-month OPRA cache (2025-01-02 to 2026-06-18) used as sample; selection method is all available data; overfit risk mitigated by walk-forward OOS and real-fills validation.
3. **Out-of-sample:** NEEDS-OOS (walk-forward held-out window to be executed as part of this candidate).
4. **Real-fills:** NEEDS-REAL-FILLS (real-fills check on top-3 J days to be executed as part of this candidate).
5. **Failure modes:** Worst day: large loss on a J loser day if engine takes the trade; max drawdown scenario: consecutive loser days exceeding risk limits; blow-up scenario: engine taking multiple large losers due to faulty trigger or exit logic.
6. **Concentration:** To be measured after Stage-1 backtest (top-5 days % of P&L will be reported post-validation).

## Pre-merge gate

- Gym validators must pass (e.g., `test_*_grinder.py`).
- Walk-forward OOS edge_capture must be non-negative (or at least not degrade baseline by >10%).
- Real-fills validation on top-3 J days must show < ±20% diff from BS-sim.
- No regression on anchor days (engine must take all three winner days and skip or lose less on loser days).

## Confidence

5 / 10 -- Baseline measurement has not yet been run; confidence will increase after Stage-1 backtest, OOS, and real-fills validation are completed.

## Pre-existing leaderboard impact

This candidate does not conflict with existing candidates; it provides a baseline edge_capture measurement against which all other candidates in the leaderboard can be compared. It complements the leaderboard by enabling objective assessment of edge_capture improvements.
